# Vue Component Designer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Vue

## Overview

Designs and builds reusable Vue components with Composition API, slots, provide/inject, and proper TypeScript integration

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [vue-component-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
vue-component-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@vue-component-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design components with Composition API and script setup
- Implement scoped slots for flexible content projection
- Use provide/inject for dependency injection patterns
- Build v-model compatible custom input components

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Vue Style Guide**: Official component design patterns and naming conventions
- **Composition API**: Composable patterns for logic reuse
- **TypeScript Integration**: Proper typing for props, emits, and slots
